description: This Java class defines a Fragment called TreeFragment that displays a hierarchical list of tasks and activities in an Android application, using RecyclerView and ViewModel architecture components.

classes.name: TreeFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a hierarchical list of tasks and activities, supporting expansion and interaction.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and retrieves the title argument.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel and sets up observation for data refresh.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Triggers an action to show the floating action button.

methods.name: onResumeHelper
methods.description: Updates the UI with the list of tasks when data is refreshed.

methods.name: displayRecycler
methods.description: Configures the RecyclerView with an adapter and layout manager to display tasks.

methods.name: openTask
methods.description: Expands a task group to show its child activities by simulating a click.
